review: [Cinq Assoc. East Section 3] Don Quixote is the first true ID that utilizes Burn and Poise together while also utilizing the Speed and Duel aspect of the Cinq faction. Cinq East Don’s main strength lies in focused encounters where she can stack “Nerve Strike - Don Quixote”. “Nerve Strike - Don Quixote” is a status that is split into 3 stacks and is inflicted on her last Base Skill hit if her Passive is active. It increases by 1 every time Cinq Don attacks the target with the status. - 1x Stack: Gain Clash Power +1 - 2x Stack: Gain Base Power +1 - 3x Stack: Gain Clash Power +1 and Base Power +1 Aside from these she also gains more Crit Damage from this status. While it may sound powerful, it has the same problem as Cinq Meursault, albeit less problematic as you are forced to target only one enemy/part to get the full benefits, which may not be an option always.
